plan.scope: IPv4 Reality-TLS data-phase metadata pilot, not browser equivalence or industrial DPI certification
plan.preflight: One extra complete block excluded from classifier, plus no-capture VoIP control in each arm. Capture self CPU retained; no claim of zero observer effect.
plan.capture: 301 eth1, kernel-filtered test peer TCP 443/8443; JSON timestamp/direction/header lengths/seq/ack only, no packet bytes or TLS secrets
plan.offloads: Save and disable GRO/GSO/TSO/rx-gro-hw on test eth1 symmetrically; verify and restore. Not a throughput tuning comparison.
plan.control: Genuine TLS1.3/H2 streaming echo of identical useful payload cadence; own synthetic H2 application, NOT a browser or representative Internet corpus

analysis.models: Predeclared L2 logistic regression, blocked leave-one-session-block-out; full features and timing-only ablation; fixed threshold 0.5, empirical TPR/FPR and AUC
analysis.split: All four workload windows from a connection remain in one block; exclude IP/port/cert/handshake/labels as features
analysis.limits: Only 10 independent flows per class. No 0.1%/1% FPR claims; report broad uncertainty and ceiling effects. Distinguishing modes is not VPN detection.
analysis.quality_gates: No capture socket drops; input send shortfall <=1%, pace p99 lateness retained; same offered payloads/rates. Initial failures retained, no overwrite.

plan.restoration: Stop only owned processes; restore network/offloads and usage file; preserve old binaries/raw and private new metadata. No rebuild/reboot/Proxmox/release publication.

spec.clarification: The frozen plan's packets-per-useful-message ratio needs sender ground truth. Retain it descriptively, but exclude it from passive classifier inputs. Do not substitute hidden labels or tune features after observing results.
spec.model: Train-only mean/std standardization, class-balanced L2 logistic regression, lambda=0.1, 1000 fixed gradient steps, learning rate 0.2; no hyperparameter search
spec.split: Leave out one of 10 chronological session blocks, including all modes/control and workload windows of that block. Aggregate four window scores to one flow score.
spec.aggregation: Primary mean of four window scores; also retain maximum-window sensitivity analysis, reported separately rather than choosing a favorable aggregation. Declared before feature extraction.
spec.scores: Fixed threshold 0.5; report empirical per-mode TPR and shared H2 FPR, Wilson 95% intervals, pooled out-of-fold AUROC. Scores are not real-world detection probabilities.
spec.quality: Capture drops must be zero. Log generator pacing and echo loss. No post-hoc deletion of noisy valid windows. If workload pacing is materially different, report confounding rather than assigning all separation to batching.

caveats: 10 independent flows per class; no reliable 1%/0.1% FPR claim
Matched synthetic H2 stream is not a browser or broad Internet negative corpus
Cross-validated scores are not probabilities of detection by a real censor
Headers/data phase only; handshake and active probing intentionally outside this comparison
Existing synchronous usage writes and VM scheduling may contribute tails; retain pacing and loss data
Wilson intervals do not include model-selection/domain-shift uncertainty

observer_controls.qualification: One sequential preflight pair, not proof of zero observer overhead; bulk has no no-capture pair
